title: Prototype 2D LiDAR Sensor Development
desc:
I am building a proof-of-concept 2D LiDAR unit from the ground up and need a mainland-based embedded electronics engineer who can handle every step of the design and bring-up process. The goal is a compact indoor scanner that excels at obstacle detection and terrain mapping while holding tight, high-accuracy tolerances.

What the work involves  
You will take the idea from blank sheet to working board: optical layout, high-speed signal processing, motor/galvo drive, power management, firmware, and a simple USB/TTL data interface that streams polar coordinates for fusion in my existing SLAM stack. Expect heavy use of Altium (or KiCad), STM32/ESP32 class MCUs, precise timing control in C/C++, and low-level debugging with J-Link or OpenOCD. I will handle mechanical housing once you define envelope and mounting points.

Key expectations  
• Accuracy and repeatability must match typical 0.1° angular resolution and ≤3 cm range error across a 6 m indoor span.  
• Mapping frame rate: ≥10 Hz full sweep.  
• Sensor should self-calibrate on power-up and deliver clean packets over UART.  
• All design files remain editable; no locked libraries or black-box binaries.

Deliverables  
1. Complete schematic, PCB layout, and fabrication files.  
2. Bill of materials with China-sourced components in mind.  
3. Compiled and source firmware, plus flashing instructions.  
4. Lab test report demonstrating accuracy targets met indoors.  
5. Short video of the unit performing real-time obstacle dete

title: Remote Airbnb Property Manager
desc:
I need a reliable, tech-savvy partner to take full day-to-day control of my single-family Airbnb homes. Your core focus will be threefold:  

• Handle all guest communications from pre-booking questions through post-checkout reviews, keeping response times fast and tone consistently warm and professional.  
• Coordinate cleanings and any on-the-ground maintenance by liaising with my local cleaners, handymen, and landscapers, ensuring turnovers are spotless and any issues are resolved without delay.  
• Own the listings themselves—updating pricing and availability, refining descriptions, uploading photos, and watching performance metrics so the properties stay high in Airbnb search results.  

Everything can be done remotely as long as you’re comfortable working inside the Airbnb host dashboard (or their mobile app), using common tools like Google Workspace, Slack/WhatsApp for quick updates, and a channel manager if we adopt one later.  

I already have established house manuals, cleaner checklists, and vendor contacts; you’ll tighten the process, keep records tidy, and surface any improvements you spot. Clear weekly activity reports and immediate flagging of guest or maintenance issues will be the main deliverables. If you thrive on proactive communication and have proven experience managing short-term rentals, let’s talk—I’m looking to start hand-off within the next two weeks.

title: Nhập Dữ Liệu Excel Tại Nhà
desc:

Bạn sẽ nhận file nguồn (văn bản, hình ảnh rõ ràng, link web…) và chuyển nội dung sang workbook Excel do tôi cung cấp sẵn mẫu. Miễn là bạn đã quen thao tác cơ bản trong Excel – điền ô, định dạng, dùng công thức SUM, COUNT, v.v. – là đủ. Kinh nghiệm nhập liệu trước đây không bắt buộc; tôi sẽ hướng dẫn chi tiết quy trình kiểm tra độ chính xác.

Deliverables
• Các sheet Excel hoàn chỉnh, không lỗi chính tả, đúng định dạng  
• Báo cáo nhỏ (1-2 dòng) ghi chú chỗ dữ liệu nghi ngờ hoặc thiếu  

Chỉ cần máy tính kết nối Internet, tinh thần cẩn thận và sẵn sàng làm việc theo deadline ngắn. Gửi cho tôi một mẫu bất kỳ bạn từng soạn trên Excel (có thể ẩn thông tin nhạy cảm) để tôi đánh giá cách trình bày trước khi trao đổi bước tiếp theo.

title: PDF Invoice Data Entry Assistant
desc:
I have a continuous flow of supplier invoices and sales receipts that arrive as PDFs. Each file needs to be opened, read, and its key details—date, vendor, invoice or receipt number, amounts, taxes, and notes—entered into the tracking sheet I provide. The PDFs are text-based, so no OCR setup is required; accuracy and consistency are what matter most.

You will receive the documents in a shared cloud folder and record the information in either Google Sheets or Excel, whichever you find faster. I’ll review entries at the end of every batch and provide quick feedback so we can keep error rates to an absolute minimum. Data must stay confidential, so please be comfortable signing a simple NDA before we begin.

Deliverables  
• Updated spreadsheet for every batch of PDFs  
• A brief message flagging any illegible or missing fields

Acceptance Criteria  
• 100 % of assigned invoices/receipts entered  
• Fewer than 1 % transcription errors per batch  

If you enjoy straightforward data entry and can turn around small sets quickly, let’s get started.

title: Aplikasi Akuntansi Gaji Antipenipuan

title: Psychological Horror Short Story
desc:
I want to commission a tightly-written psychological horror short story that leaves readers unsettled long after the last line. The narrative should rely on tension, unreliable perceptions, and creeping dread rather than overt gore.  

Scope  
• Length: an agreed-upon short-story range (roughly 3,000–6,000 words; we can fine-tune once we outline).  
• Tone: claustrophobic, slow-burn suspense that escalates to a shocking but believable climax.  
• Originality: no tropes lifted directly from existing works—fresh twists only.  
• Delivery format: editable file in Word or Google Docs, with standard manuscript formatting.

Acceptance Criteria  
• A complete story arc with a protagonist whose sanity—or perception of reality—erodes convincingly.  
• Psychological horror elements must drive the plot; any supernatural hints should remain ambiguous unless we decide otherwise during outline approval.  
• One round of revisions after my initial read-through to polish pacing, characterization, and atmosphere.

Once we agree on a one-paragraph pitch, you’ll draft a concise outline for sign-off before writing the full piece. Please share a brief sample or link that showcases your horror or dark-fiction style so I can confirm the voice matches the mood I’m after.
